# Socrates Quiz

> High-difficulty IT quiz app. Monorepo, not a published library. Public JSON is OpenAPI + fixtures + handwritten Zod. Learning trees (samples/, archive/, docs/security-tools/) are not product.

## Detailed design

- [Detailed design](docs/detailed-design/README.md): Internal assembly docs — handlers, SQL, Zod refine, in-page state. Not the public OpenAPI contract.

- [書き方](docs/detailed-design/README.md#書き方)
- [含めるもの / 含めないもの](docs/detailed-design/README.md#含めるもの-含めないもの)
